'''2008 Worlds Team Greg Shaw LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title SUPER LARS. Starting Slave Quarters / farm package; treated as Mind What You Have Learned. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
